newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Monfel to use IPO funds for plant expansion.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Monfel to use IPO funds for plant expansion.

text.p: Mexican chemical company Monfel plans to use funds from its $140-million-peso initial public offering to build two new plants and upgrade an existing one, a spokesman for the placement agent said Wednesday.

"The funds will be mainly chanelled into expanding Monfel's plant in San Luis Potosi, to build a plant to produce paracetomol and another for acetylsalicylic acid, the main component of aspirin," Javier Pardo, associate director of equities trading at Interacciones brokerage in Mexico City, told Reuters.
Monfel began its IPO on Wednesday.
